newsitem.title: UK: Thermo of U.S. to buy UK's Life Sciences.
newsitem.headline: Thermo of U.S. to buy UK's Life Sciences.

text.p: Thermo Instrument Systems Inc of the U.S. said on Tuesday that it was making a recommended cash bid for Life Sciences International Plc, valuing the scientific equipment firm at 235.9 million pounds ($392 million).
The offer will be 135 pence per share in Life Sciences compared with a close on Monday of 92-1/2 pence. The shares leapt 40 pence to 132-1/2 in early trade after news of the bid.

Thermo said in a statement that Life Sciences, which is recommending acceptance of the bid, intends to declare a second interim dividend, in place of any final dividend, for the year ended December 31, 1996 of 3.0 pence per share.
It said the offer together with the second interim dividend represented a premium of around 49 percent over Monday's closing price.
Life Sciences said it expected its profit before tax and exceptional items for the year ended December 31, 1996 to be around 27.0 million pounds.

Christopher Bland, chairman of Life Sciences, said: "Thermo Instrument will bring to Life Sciences greater financial resources, operating synergies and further expansion opportunities." ($1=.6021 Pound)
